# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (System.getenv("BASE_URL")).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Java DSL only (io.gatling.javaapi.*); the harness compiles ModelSimulation.java with javac and runs it without reports.

import io.gatling.javaapi.core.*;
import io.gatling.javaapi.http.*;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.net.URI;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import static io.gatling.javaapi.core.CoreDsl.*;
import static io.gatling.javaapi.http.HttpDsl.*;
import static java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS;

public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation {
  private static final String BASE_URL =
      System.getenv("BASE_URL") == null || System.getenv("BASE_URL").isEmpty()
          ? "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
          : System.getenv("BASE_URL");
  private static final String ORIGIN = BASE_URL.replaceAll("/+$", "");

  private final HttpProtocolBuilder httpProtocol =
      http.baseUrl(BASE_URL)
          .disableFollowRedirect()
          .acceptHeader("application/json, text/html");

  public ModelSimulation() {
    setUp(
        scenario("Order journey")
            .exec(
                session ->
                    session.set(
                        "username",
                        "bench-" + (Math.floorMod((int) session.userId(), 16) + 1)))
            .exec(repeat(2).on(journey()))
            .injectOpen(atOnceUsers(2))
    ).protocols(httpProtocol);
  }

  private static ChainBuilder journey() {
    return exec(
            session ->
                session
                    .set("catalogFound", false)
                    .set("catalogNext", "")
                    .set("catalogCurrent", "/v2/catalog")
                    .set("productId", "")
                    .set("productIdJson", "null")
                    .set("variantId", "")
                    .set("variantIdJson", "null")
                    .set("cartId", "")
                    .set("cartIdJson", "null")
                    .set("cartEtag", "")
                    .set("grantId", "")
                    .set("challengeLocation", "")
                    .set("reservationUrl", "")
                    .set("reservationId", "")
                    .set("reservationState", "pending")
                    .set("reservationReady", false)
                    .set("reservationFailed", false)
                    .set("opStatus", 0)
                    .set("opError", "")
                    .set("orderAccepted", false)
                    .set("loginLocation", ""))
        .exec(loginChain())
        .exec(catalogChain())
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(challengeChain())
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(cartCreationChain())
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(cartUpdateChain())
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(reservationChain())
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(orderChain());
  }

  private static ChainBuilder loginChain() {
    return exec(
            http("login form")
                .get("/v2/login-form")
                .check(
                    status().is(200),
                    css(
                            "form[action*='/v2/login'] input[name='csrf']",
                            "value")
                        .saveAs("loginFormCsrf")))
        .exec(
            session ->
                session
                    .set("loginStatus", 0)
                    .set("loginLocation", ""))
        .exec(
            http("login")
                .post("/v2/login")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .body(
                    StringBody(
                        session ->
                            "{\"username\":"
                                + quote(session.getString("username"))
                                + ",\"password\":\"bench\",\"csrf\":"
                                + quote(session.getString("loginFormCsrf"))
                                + "}"))
                .check(
                    status().in(200, 302).saveAs("loginStatus"),
                    header("Location").optional().saveAs("loginLocation"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().optional().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate)
        .exec(
            doIf(session -> session.getInt("loginStatus") == 302)
                .then(
                    exec(
                            http("login redirect target")
                                .get("#{loginLocation}")
                                .check(
                                    status().is(200),
                                    jsonPath("$.csrf")
                                        .ofString()
                                        .saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
                        .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate)));
  }

  private static ChainBuilder catalogChain() {
    return exec(
            http("catalog")
                .get("/v2/catalog")
                .check(status().is(200), bodyString().saveAs("catalogBody")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::selectCatalogProduct)
        .exec(
            repeat(2)
                .on(
                    doIf(
                            session ->
                                !Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("catalogFound"))
                                    && !safeString(session, "catalogNext").isEmpty())
                        .then(
                            exec(
                                    http("catalog page")
                                        .get("#{catalogNext}")
                                        .check(
                                            status().is(200),
                                            bodyString().saveAs("catalogBody")))
                                .exec(ModelSimulation::selectCatalogProduct))))
        .exec(
            session ->
                Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("catalogFound"))
                    ? session
                    : session.markAsFailed())
        .exitHereIfFailed();
  }

  private static ChainBuilder challengeChain() {
    return exec(
            http("challenge form")
                .get("/v2/challenge-form")
                .check(
                    status().is(200),
                    css(
                            "form[action^='/v2/challenges/']",
                            "action")
                        .saveAs("challengeAction"),
                    css(
                            "form[action^='/v2/challenges/'] input[name='challenge']",
                            "value")
                        .saveAs("challengeValue")))
        .exec(
            session ->
                session
                    .set("opStatus", 0)
                    .set("opError", "")
                    .set("challengeLocation", ""))
        .exec(challengePost(false))
        .exec(
            doIf(session -> session.getInt("opStatus") == 401)
                .then(
                    recoveryChain(false)
                        .exec(
                            doIf(session -> !session.isFailed())
                                .then(challengePost(true)))))
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(
            session ->
                safeString(session, "challengeLocation").isEmpty()
                    ? session.markAsFailed()
                    : session)
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(
            http("claim challenge")
                .get("#{challengeLocation}")
                .check(
                    status().is(200),
                    jsonPath("$.grant_id").ofString().saveAs("grantId"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate);
  }

  private static ChainBuilder challengePost(boolean retry) {
    if (retry) {
      return exec(
              http("submit challenge retry")
                  .post("#{challengeAction}")
                  .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                  .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                  .body(
                      StringBody(
                          session ->
                              "{\"challenge\":"
                                  + quote(session.getString("challengeValue"))
                                  + "}"))
                  .check(
                      status().is(302).saveAs("opStatus"),
                      header("Location").saveAs("challengeLocation"),
                      jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().optional().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
          .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate);
    }

    return exec(
            http("submit challenge")
                .post("#{challengeAction}")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .body(
                    StringBody(
                        session ->
                            "{\"challenge\":"
                                + quote(session.getString("challengeValue"))
                                + "}"))
                .check(
                    status().in(302, 401).saveAs("opStatus"),
                    header("Location").optional().saveAs("challengeLocation"),
                    jsonPath("$.error").ofString().optional().saveAs("opError"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().optional().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate);
  }

  private static ChainBuilder cartCreationChain() {
    return exec(
            session ->
                session
                    .set("opStatus", 0)
                    .set("opError", "")
                    .set("cartId", "")
                    .set("cartIdJson", "null"))
        .exec(cartCreatePost(false))
        .exec(
            doIf(session -> session.getInt("opStatus") == 401)
                .then(
                    recoveryChain(false)
                        .exec(
                            doIf(session -> !session.isFailed())
                                .then(cartCreatePost(true)))))
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(
            session ->
                safeString(session, "cartId").isEmpty()
                    ? session.markAsFailed()
                    : session);
  }

  private static ChainBuilder cartCreatePost(boolean retry) {
    String requestName = retry ? "create cart retry" : "create cart";
    if (retry) {
      return exec(
              http(requestName)
                  .post("/v2/carts")
                  .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                  .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                  .body(
                      StringBody(
                          session ->
                              "{\"product_id\":"
                                  + session.getString("productIdJson")
                                  + ",\"variant_id\":"
                                  + session.getString("variantIdJson")
                                  + ",\"grant_id\":"
                                  + quote(session.getString("grantId"))
                                  + "}"))
                  .check(status().is(201), bodyString().saveAs("cartResponse")))
          .exec(ModelSimulation::recordCartResponse);
    }

    return exec(
            http(requestName)
                .post("/v2/carts")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .body(
                    StringBody(
                        session ->
                            "{\"product_id\":"
                                + session.getString("productIdJson")
                                + ",\"variant_id\":"
                                + session.getString("variantIdJson")
                                + ",\"grant_id\":"
                                + quote(session.getString("grantId"))
                                + "}"))
                .check(
                    status().in(201, 401).saveAs("opStatus"),
                    bodyString().saveAs("cartResponse"),
                    jsonPath("$.error").ofString().optional().saveAs("opError")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::recordCartResponse);
  }

  private static ChainBuilder cartUpdateChain() {
    return exec(
            http("read cart before update")
                .get("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")
                .check(status().is(200), header("ETag").saveAs("cartEtag")))
        .exec(
            session ->
                session
                    .set("opStatus", 0)
                    .set("opError", ""))
        .exec(patchCart(false))
        .exec(
            doIf(session -> session.getInt("opStatus") == 401)
                .then(
                    recoveryChain(true)
                        .exec(
                            doIf(session -> !session.isFailed())
                                .then(patchCart(true)))))
        .exec(
            doIf(session -> session.getInt("opStatus") == 412)
                .then(
                    exec(
                            http("re-read cart after 412")
                                .get("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")
                                .check(
                                    status().is(200),
                                    header("ETag").saveAs("cartEtag")))
                        .exec(patchCartFinal())))
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(
            http("read cart before checkout")
                .get("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")
                .check(status().is(200), header("ETag").saveAs("cartEtag")));
  }

  private static ChainBuilder patchCart(boolean retry) {
    String requestName = retry ? "update cart retry" : "update cart";
    return exec(
            http(requestName)
                .patch("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .header("If-Match", "#{cartEtag}")
                .body(StringBody("{\"quantity\":1}"))
                .check(
                    status().in(200, 204, 412, 401).saveAs("opStatus"),
                    header("ETag").optional().saveAs("cartEtag"),
                    jsonPath("$.error").ofString().optional().saveAs("opError"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().optional().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate);
  }

  private static ChainBuilder patchCartFinal() {
    return exec(
            http("update cart after 412")
                .patch("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .header("If-Match", "#{cartEtag}")
                .body(StringBody("{\"quantity\":1}"))
                .check(
                    status().in(200, 204),
                    header("ETag").optional().saveAs("cartEtag"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().optional().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate);
  }

  private static ChainBuilder reservationChain() {
    return exec(
            session ->
                session
                    .set("opStatus", 0)
                    .set("opError", "")
                    .set("reservationUrl", ""))
        .exec(reservationPost(false))
        .exec(
            doIf(session -> session.getInt("opStatus") == 401)
                .then(
                    recoveryChain(true)
                        .exec(
                            doIf(session -> !session.isFailed())
                                .then(reservationPost(true)))))
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(
            session ->
                safeString(session, "reservationUrl").isEmpty()
                    ? session.markAsFailed()
                    : session
                        .set("reservationReady", false)
                        .set("reservationFailed", false)
                        .set("reservationState", "pending"))
        .repeat(5)
        .on(
            doIf(
                    session ->
                        !Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("reservationReady"))
                            && !Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("reservationFailed")))
                .then(
                    pause(50, MILLISECONDS)
                        .exec(
                            session ->
                                session.set("reservationId", ""))
                        .exec(
                            http("poll reservation")
                                .get("#{reservationUrl}")
                                .check(
                                    status().is(200),
                                    jsonPath("$.status")
                                        .ofString()
                                        .saveAs("reservationState"),
                                    jsonPath("$.reservation_id")
                                        .ofString()
                                        .optional()
                                        .saveAs("reservationId")))
                        .exec(ModelSimulation::recordReservationPoll)))
        .exec(
            session ->
                Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("reservationReady"))
                    ? session
                    : session.markAsFailed())
        .exitHereIfFailed();
  }

  private static ChainBuilder reservationPost(boolean retry) {
    String requestName = retry ? "create reservation retry" : "create reservation";
    if (retry) {
      return exec(
              http(requestName)
                  .post("/v2/reservations")
                  .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                  .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                  .body(
                      StringBody(
                          session ->
                              "{\"cart_id\":"
                                  + session.getString("cartIdJson")
                                  + "}"))
                  .check(
                      status().is(202),
                      jsonPath("$.status_url").ofString().saveAs("reservationUrl"),
                      jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().optional().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
          .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate);
    }

    return exec(
            http(requestName)
                .post("/v2/reservations")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .body(
                    StringBody(
                        session ->
                            "{\"cart_id\":"
                                + session.getString("cartIdJson")
                                + "}"))
                .check(
                    status().in(202, 401).saveAs("opStatus"),
                    jsonPath("$.status_url")
                        .ofString()
                        .optional()
                        .saveAs("reservationUrl"),
                    jsonPath("$.error").ofString().optional().saveAs("opError"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().optional().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate);
  }

  private static ChainBuilder orderChain() {
    return exec(
            session ->
                session
                    .set("opStatus", 0)
                    .set("opError", "")
                    .set("orderAccepted", false))
        .exec(orderPost(false))
        .exec(
            doIf(session -> session.getInt("opStatus") == 401)
                .then(
                    recoveryChain(true)
                        .exec(
                            doIf(session -> !session.isFailed())
                                .then(orderPost(true)))))
        .exitHereIfFailed()
        .exec(
            session ->
                session.getInt("opStatus") == 201
                        && Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("orderAccepted"))
                    ? session
                    : session.markAsFailed())
        .exitHereIfFailed();
  }

  private static ChainBuilder orderPost(boolean retry) {
    if (retry) {
      return exec(
              http("commit order retry")
                  .post("/v2/orders")
                  .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                  .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                  .header("If-Match", "#{cartEtag}")
                  .header("Idempotency-Key", "order-#{cartId}")
                  .body(
                      StringBody(
                          session ->
                              "{\"cart_id\":"
                                  + session.getString("cartIdJson")
                                  + ",\"reservation_id\":"
                                  + quote(session.getString("reservationId"))
                                  + "}"))
                  .check(
                      status().is(201),
                      jsonPath("$.accepted").ofBoolean().is(true),
                      jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().optional().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
          .exec(session -> session.set("orderAccepted", true))
          .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate);
    }

    return exec(
            http("commit order")
                .post("/v2/orders")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .header("If-Match", "#{cartEtag}")
                .header("Idempotency-Key", "order-#{cartId}")
                .body(
                    StringBody(
                        session ->
                            "{\"cart_id\":"
                                + session.getString("cartIdJson")
                                + ",\"reservation_id\":"
                                + quote(session.getString("reservationId"))
                                + "}"))
                .check(
                    status().in(201, 401).saveAs("opStatus"),
                    jsonPath("$.accepted")
                        .ofBoolean()
                        .optional()
                        .saveAs("orderAccepted"),
                    jsonPath("$.error").ofString().optional().saveAs("opError"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().optional().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate);
  }

  private static ChainBuilder recoveryChain(boolean cartExists) {
    return exec(
            doIf(session -> "expired".equals(safeString(session, "opError")))
                .then(
                    exec(
                            http("renew session")
                                .post("/v2/session/renew")
                                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                                .body(StringBody("{}"))
                                .check(
                                    status().is(200),
                                    jsonPath("$.csrf")
                                        .ofString()
                                        .optional()
                                        .saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
                        .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate)
                        .exec(
                            doIf(session -> !session.isFailed())
                                .then(cartExists ? recoverCartChain() : exec(s -> s)))))
        .exec(
            doIf(session -> "session".equals(safeString(session, "opError")))
                .then(
                    loginChain()
                        .exec(
                            doIf(session -> !session.isFailed())
                                .then(cartExists ? recoverCartChain() : exec(s -> s)))))
        .exec(
            doIf(
                    session ->
                        !"expired".equals(safeString(session, "opError"))
                            && !"session".equals(safeString(session, "opError")))
                .then(exec(Session::markAsFailed)));
  }

  private static ChainBuilder recoverCartChain() {
    return exec(
            http("recover cart")
                .post("/v2/carts/#{cartId}/recover")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .body(StringBody("{}"))
                .check(
                    status().is(200),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").ofString().optional().saveAs("csrfCandidate")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::applyCsrfCandidate)
        .exec(
            http("read recovered cart")
                .get("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")
                .check(status().is(200), header("ETag").saveAs("cartEtag")));
  }

  private static Session applyCsrfCandidate(Session session) {
    if (session.contains("csrfCandidate")) {
      Object candidate = session.get("csrfCandidate");
      if (candidate != null && !candidate.toString().isEmpty()) {
        return session.set("csrf", candidate.toString());
      }
    }
    return session;
  }

  private static Session recordCartResponse(Session session) {
    try {
      Object parsed = new JsonParser(session.getString("cartResponse")).parse();
      if (!(parsed instanceof Map)) {
        return session.markAsFailed();
      }
      Map<?, ?> body = (Map<?, ?>) parsed;
      Object id = body.get("id");
      if (id != null) {
        session =
            session
                .set("cartId", scalarString(id))
                .set("cartIdJson", jsonLiteral(id));
      }
      Object csrf = body.get("csrf");
      if (csrf != null) {
        session = session.set("csrf", scalarString(csrf));
      }
      return session;
    } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
      return session.markAsFailed();
    }
  }

  private static Session selectCatalogProduct(Session session) {
    try {
      Object parsed = new JsonParser(session.getString("catalogBody")).parse();
      if (!(parsed instanceof Map)) {
        return session.markAsFailed();
      }
      Map<?, ?> root = (Map<?, ?>) parsed;
      Object dataValue = root.get("data");
      Map<?, ?> data = dataValue instanceof Map ? (Map<?, ?>) dataValue : root;
      Object productsValue = data.get("products");
      List<?> products = productsValue instanceof List ? (List<?>) productsValue : new ArrayList<>();

      if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("catalogFound"))) {
        for (Object productValue : products) {
          if (!(productValue instanceof Map)) {
            continue;
          }
          Map<?, ?> product = (Map<?, ?>) productValue;
          Object productId = product.get("id");
          Object variantsValue = product.get("variants");
          if (productId == null || !(variantsValue instanceof List)) {
            continue;
          }
          for (Object variantValue : (List<?>) variantsValue) {
            if (!(variantValue instanceof Map)) {
              continue;
            }
            Map<?, ?> variant = (Map<?, ?>) variantValue;
            Object variantId = variant.get("id");
            if (variantId != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(variant.get("in_stock"))) {
              session =
                  session
                      .set("productId", scalarString(productId))
                      .set("productIdJson", jsonLiteral(productId))
                      .set("variantId", scalarString(variantId))
                      .set("variantIdJson", jsonLiteral(variantId))
                      .set("catalogFound", true);
              break;
            }
          }
          if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("catalogFound"))) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      Object next = root.get("next");
      if (next == null) {
        session = session.set("catalogNext", "");
      } else {
        String resolved =
            resolveCatalogNext(
                safeString(session, "catalogCurrent"), scalarString(next));
        session =
            session
                .set("catalogNext", resolved)
                .set("catalogCurrent", resolved);
      }
      return session;
    } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
      return session.markAsFailed();
    }
  }

  private static String resolveCatalogNext(String current, String next) {
    URI base = URI.create(ORIGIN + (current.startsWith("/") ? current : "/" + current));
    URI resolved = base.resolve(next);
    String path = resolved.getRawPath() == null ? "/" : resolved.getRawPath();
    return path + (resolved.getRawQuery() == null ? "" : "?" + resolved.getRawQuery());
  }

  private static Session recordReservationPoll(Session session) {
    String state = safeString(session, "reservationState");
    boolean ready =
        "ready".equals(state) && !safeString(session, "reservationId").isEmpty();
    boolean failed = "failed".equals(state) || ("ready".equals(state) && !ready);
    return session
        .set("reservationReady", ready)
        .set("reservationFailed", failed)
        .markAsFailedIf(false);
  }

  private static String safeString(Session session, String key) {
    if (!session.contains(key)) {
      return "";
    }
    Object value = session.get(key);
    return value == null ? "" : value.toString();
  }

  private static String scalarString(Object value) {
    return value == null ? "" : value.toString();
  }

  private static String quote(String value) {
    StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder("\"");
    for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
      char c = value.charAt(i);
      switch (c) {
        case '"':
          out.append("\\\"");
          break;
        case '\\':
          out.append("\\\\");
          break;
        case '\b':
          out.append("\\b");
          break;
        case '\f':
          out.append("\\f");
          break;
        case '\n':
          out.append("\\n");
          break;
        case '\r':
          out.append("\\r");
          break;
        case '\t':
          out.append("\\t");
          break;
        default:
          if (c < 0x20) {
            out.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
          } else {
            out.append(c);
          }
      }
    }
    return out.append('"').toString();
  }

  private static String jsonLiteral(Object value) {
    if (value == null) {
      return "null";
    }
    if (value instanceof String) {
      return quote((String) value);
    }
    if (value instanceof Number || value instanceof Boolean) {
      return value.toString();
    }
    return quote(value.toString());
  }

  private static final class JsonParser {
    private final String input;
    private int position;

    JsonParser(String input) {
      this.input = input;
    }

    Object parse() {
      skipWhitespace();
      Object value = readValue();
      skipWhitespace();
      if (position != input.length()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Trailing JSON content");
      }
      return value;
    }

    private Object readValue() {
      skipWhitespace();
      if (position >= input.length()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected end of JSON");
      }
      char c = input.charAt(position);
      if (c == '{') {
        return readObject();
      }
      if (c == '[') {
        return readArray();
      }
      if (c == '"') {
        return readString();
      }
      if (c == 't') {
        expectLiteral("true");
        return Boolean.TRUE;
      }
      if (c == 'f') {
        expectLiteral("false");
        return Boolean.FALSE;
      }
      if (c == 'n') {
        expectLiteral("null");
        return null;
      }
      return readNumber();
    }

    private Map<String, Object> readObject() {
      Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
      position++;
      skipWhitespace();
      if (take('}')) {
        return result;
      }
      while (true) {
        skipWhitespace();
        String key = readString();
        skipWhitespace();
        require(':');
        result.put(key, readValue());
        skipWhitespace();
        if (take('}')) {
          return result;
        }
        require(',');
      }
    }

    private List<Object> readArray() {
      List<Object> result = new ArrayList<>();
      position++;
      skipWhitespace();
      if (take(']')) {
        return result;
      }
      while (true) {
        result.add(readValue());
        skipWhitespace();
        if (take(']')) {
          return result;
        }
        require(',');
      }
    }

    private String readString() {
      require('"');
      StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
      while (position < input.length()) {
        char c = input.charAt(position++);
        if (c == '"') {
          return result.toString();
        }
        if (c != '\\') {
          result.append(c);
          continue;
        }
        if (position >= input.length()) {
          throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON escape");
        }
        char escaped = input.charAt(position++);
        switch (escaped) {
          case '"':
          case '\\':
          case '/':
            result.append(escaped);
            break;
          case 'b':
            result.append('\b');
            break;
          case 'f':
            result.append('\f');
            break;
          case 'n':
            result.append('\n');
            break;
          case 'r':
            result.append('\r');
            break;
          case 't':
            result.append('\t');
            break;
          case 'u':
            if (position + 4 > input.length()) {
              throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid unicode escape");
            }
            result.append((char) Integer.parseInt(input.substring(position, position + 4), 16));
            position += 4;
            break;
          default:
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON escape");
        }
      }
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unterminated JSON string");
    }

    private Number readNumber() {
      int start = position;
      while (position < input.length()) {
        char c = input.charAt(position);
        if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9')
            || c == '-'
            || c == '+'
            || c == '.'
            || c == 'e'
            || c == 'E') {
          position++;
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }
      if (start == position) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON value");
      }
      return new BigDecimal(input.substring(start, position));
    }

    private void expectLiteral(String literal) {
      if (!input.regionMatches(position, literal, 0, literal.length())) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON literal");
      }
      position += literal.length();
    }

    private void skipWhitespace() {
      while (position < input.length()
          && (input.charAt(position) == ' '
              || input.charAt(position) == '\n'
              || input.charAt(position) == '\r'
              || input.charAt(position) == '\t')) {
        position++;
      }
    }

    private boolean take(char expected) {
      if (position < input.length() && input.charAt(position) == expected) {
        position++;
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    private void require(char expected) {
      if (!take(expected)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected " + expected);
      }
    }
  }
}

  private static ChainBuilder patchCart(boolean retry) {

            http(requestName)
                .patch("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")

                .header("If-Match", "#{cartEtag}")
                .body(StringBody("{\"quantity\":1}"))
                .check(
                    status().in(200, 204, 412, 401).saveAs("opStatus"),

  private static Session selectCatalogProduct(Session session) {
    try {
      Object parsed = new JsonParser(session.getString("catalogBody")).parse();
      if (!(parsed instanceof Map)) {
        return session.markAsFailed();
      }
      Map<?, ?> root = (Map<?, ?>) parsed;
      Object dataValue = root.get("data");
      Map<?, ?> data = dataValue instanceof Map ? (Map<?, ?>) dataValue : root;
      Object productsValue = data.get("products");
      List<?> products = productsValue instanceof List ? (List<?>) productsValue : new ArrayList<>();

      if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("catalogFound"))) {
        for (Object productValue : products) {
          if (!(productValue instanceof Map)) {
            continue;
          }
          Map<?, ?> product = (Map<?, ?>) productValue;
          Object productId = product.get("id");
          Object variantsValue = product.get("variants");
          if (productId == null || !(variantsValue instanceof List)) {
            continue;
          }
          for (Object variantValue : (List<?>) variantsValue) {
            if (!(variantValue instanceof Map)) {
              continue;
            }
            Map<?, ?> variant = (Map<?, ?>) variantValue;
            Object variantId = variant.get("id");
            if (variantId != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(variant.get("in_stock"))) {
              session =
                  session
                      .set("productId", scalarString(productId))
                      .set("productIdJson", jsonLiteral(productId))
                      .set("variantId", scalarString(variantId))
                      .set("variantIdJson", jsonLiteral(variantId))
                      .set("catalogFound", true);
              break;
            }
          }
          if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("catalogFound"))) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      Object next = root.get("next");
      if (next == null) {
        session = session.set("catalogNext", "");
      } else {
        String resolved =
            resolveCatalogNext(
                safeString(session, "catalogCurrent"), scalarString(next));
        session =
            session
                .set("catalogNext", resolved)
                .set("catalogCurrent", resolved);
      }
      return session;
    } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
      return session.markAsFailed();
    }
  }

  private static String resolveCatalogNext(String current, String next) {
    URI base = URI.create(ORIGIN + (current.startsWith("/") ? current : "/" + current));
    URI resolved = base.resolve(next);
    String path = resolved.getRawPath() == null ? "/" : resolved.getRawPath();
    return path + (resolved.getRawQuery() == null ? "" : "?" + resolved.getRawQuery());
  }

  private static String quote(String value) {
    StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder("\"");
    for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
      char c = value.charAt(i);
      switch (c) {
        case '"':
          out.append("\\\"");
          break;
        case '\\':
          out.append("\\\\");
          break;
        case '\b':
          out.append("\\b");
          break;
        case '\f':
          out.append("\\f");
          break;
        case '\n':
          out.append("\\n");
          break;
        case '\r':
          out.append("\\r");
          break;
        case '\t':
          out.append("\\t");
          break;
        default:
          if (c < 0x20) {
            out.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
          } else {
            out.append(c);
          }
      }
    }
    return out.append('"').toString();
  }

      return value.toString();

  private static final class JsonParser {
    private final String input;
    private int position;

    JsonParser(String input) {
      this.input = input;
    }

    Object parse() {
      skipWhitespace();
      Object value = readValue();
      skipWhitespace();
      if (position != input.length()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Trailing JSON content");
      }
      return value;
    }

    private Object readValue() {
      skipWhitespace();
      if (position >= input.length()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected end of JSON");
      }
      char c = input.charAt(position);
      if (c == '{') {
        return readObject();
      }
      if (c == '[') {
        return readArray();
      }
      if (c == '"') {
        return readString();
      }
      if (c == 't') {
        expectLiteral("true");
        return Boolean.TRUE;
      }
      if (c == 'f') {
        expectLiteral("false");
        return Boolean.FALSE;
      }
      if (c == 'n') {
        expectLiteral("null");
        return null;
      }
      return readNumber();
    }

    private Map<String, Object> readObject() {
      Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
      position++;
      skipWhitespace();
      if (take('}')) {
        return result;
      }
      while (true) {
        skipWhitespace();
        String key = readString();
        skipWhitespace();
        require(':');
        result.put(key, readValue());
        skipWhitespace();
        if (take('}')) {
          return result;
        }
        require(',');
      }
    }

    private List<Object> readArray() {
      List<Object> result = new ArrayList<>();
      position++;
      skipWhitespace();
      if (take(']')) {
        return result;
      }
      while (true) {
        result.add(readValue());
        skipWhitespace();
        if (take(']')) {
          return result;
        }
        require(',');
      }
    }

    private String readString() {
      require('"');
      StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
      while (position < input.length()) {
        char c = input.charAt(position++);
        if (c == '"') {
          return result.toString();
        }
        if (c != '\\') {
          result.append(c);
          continue;
        }
        if (position >= input.length()) {
          throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON escape");
        }
        char escaped = input.charAt(position++);
        switch (escaped) {
          case '"':
          case '\\':
          case '/':
            result.append(escaped);
            break;
          case 'b':
            result.append('\b');
            break;
          case 'f':
            result.append('\f');
            break;
          case 'n':
            result.append('\n');
            break;
          case 'r':
            result.append('\r');
            break;
          case 't':
            result.append('\t');
            break;
          case 'u':
            if (position + 4 > input.length()) {
              throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid unicode escape");
            }
            result.append((char) Integer.parseInt(input.substring(position, position + 4), 16));
            position += 4;
            break;
          default:
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON escape");
        }
      }
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unterminated JSON string");
    }

    private Number readNumber() {
      int start = position;
      while (position < input.length()) {
        char c = input.charAt(position);
        if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9')
            || c == '-'
            || c == '+'
            || c == '.'
            || c == 'e'
            || c == 'E') {
          position++;
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }
      if (start == position) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON value");
      }
      return new BigDecimal(input.substring(start, position));
    }

    private void expectLiteral(String literal) {
      if (!input.regionMatches(position, literal, 0, literal.length())) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON literal");
      }
      position += literal.length();
    }

    private void skipWhitespace() {
      while (position < input.length()
          && (input.charAt(position) == ' '
              || input.charAt(position) == '\n'
              || input.charAt(position) == '\r'
              || input.charAt(position) == '\t')) {
        position++;
      }
    }

    private boolean take(char expected) {
      if (position < input.length() && input.charAt(position) == expected) {
        position++;
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    private void require(char expected) {
      if (!take(expected)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected " + expected);
      }
    }
  }

  private static Session validateWorkResponse(Session session) {
    if (session.isFailed()) {
      return session;
    }
    int status = session.getInt("workStatus");
    if (status == 429) {
      return "1".equals(safeString(session, "retryAfter"))
          ? session
          : session.markAsFailed();
    }
    if (status == 200) {
      try {
        Object parsed = new JsonParser(session.getString("workBody")).parse();
        if (parsed instanceof Map
            && Boolean.TRUE.equals(((Map<?, ?>) parsed).get("ok"))) {
          return session;
        }
      } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
        // The response is not a successful work response.
      }
      return session.markAsFailed();
    }
    return session;
  }

  private static Session validateFinalWorkResponse(Session session) {
    if (session.isFailed()) {

            && successfulWorkBody(safeString(session, "workBody"))
        ? session
        : session.markAsFailed();

    } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  private static Session normalizeLoginLocation(Session session) {
    String location = safeString(session, "loginLocation");
    if (location.isEmpty()) {

  }

    String location = safeString(session, "challengeLocation");

  private static String normalizeSameOriginLocation(String location) {
    URI base = URI.create(ORIGIN);
    URI resolved = base.resolve(location);
    if (resolved.getScheme() == null
        || resolved.getAuthority() == null
        || !resolved.getScheme().equalsIgnoreCase(base.getScheme())
        || !resolved.getAuthority().equalsIgnoreCase(base.getAuthority())) {
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Redirect is outside the configured origin");
    }
    String path = resolved.getRawPath() == null ? "/" : resolved.getRawPath();
    return path + (resolved.getRawQuery() == null ? "" : "?" + resolved.getRawQuery());
  }

  private static Session recordCartResponse(Session session) {
    try {
      Object parsed = new JsonParser(session.getString("cartResponse")).parse();
      if (!(parsed instanceof Map)) {

      Object id = body.get("id");
      if (id != null) {
        session =
            session

                .set("cartIdJson", jsonLiteral(id));
      }
      Object csrf = body.get("csrf");

    } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
      return session.markAsFailed();

  }

  private static Session selectCatalogProduct(Session session) {
    try {
      Object parsed = new JsonParser(session.getString("catalogBody")).parse();
      if (!(parsed instanceof Map)) {
        return session.markAsFailed();
      }

      Map<?, ?> root = (Map<?, ?>) parsed;
      Object dataValue = root.get("data");
      Map<?, ?> data = dataValue instanceof Map ? (Map<?, ?>) dataValue : root;
      Object productsValue = data.get("products");
      List<?> products =
          productsValue instanceof List ? (List<?>) productsValue : new ArrayList<>();

      if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("catalogFound"))) {
        for (Object productValue : products) {
          if (!(productValue instanceof Map)) {
            continue;
          }
          Map<?, ?> product = (Map<?, ?>) productValue;
          Object productId = product.get("id");
          Object variantsValue = product.get("variants");
          if (productId == null || !(variantsValue instanceof List)) {
            continue;
          }

          for (Object variantValue : (List<?>) variantsValue) {
            if (!(variantValue instanceof Map)) {
              continue;
            }
            Map<?, ?> variant = (Map<?, ?>) variantValue;
            Object variantId = variant.get("id");
            if (variantId != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(variant.get("in_stock"))) {
              session =
                  session
                      .set("productId", scalarString(productId))
                      .set("productIdJson", jsonLiteral(productId))
                      .set("variantId", scalarString(variantId))
                      .set("variantIdJson", jsonLiteral(variantId))
                      .set("catalogFound", true);
              break;
            }
          }

          if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(session.get("catalogFound"))) {
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      Object next = root.get("next");
      if (next == null) {
        return session.set("catalogNext", "");
      }

      String resolved =
          resolveCatalogNext(
              safeString(session, "catalogCurrent"), scalarString(next));
      return session
          .set("catalogNext", resolved)
          .set("catalogCurrent", resolved);
    } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
      return session.markAsFailed();
    }
  }

  private static String resolveCatalogNext(String current, String next) {
    URI base = URI.create(ORIGIN + (current.startsWith("/") ? current : "/" + current));
    URI resolved = base.resolve(next);
    String path = resolved.getRawPath() == null ? "/" : resolved.getRawPath();
    return path + (resolved.getRawQuery() == null ? "" : "?" + resolved.getRawQuery());
  }

  private static Session recordReservationPoll(Session session) {
    String state = safeString(session, "reservationState");
    boolean ready =
        "ready".equals(state) && !safeString(session, "reservationId").isEmpty();
    boolean failed = "failed".equals(state) || ("ready".equals(state) && !ready);
    return session
        .set("reservationReady", ready)
        .set("reservationFailed", failed);
  }

  private static String safeString(Session session, String key) {
    if (!session.contains(key)) {
      return "";
    }
    Object value = session.get(key);
    return value == null ? "" : value.toString();
  }

  private static String scalarString(Object value) {
    return value == null ? "" : value.toString();
  }

  private static String quote(String value) {
    StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder("\"");
    for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
      char c = value.charAt(i);
      switch (c) {
        case '"':
          out.append("\\\"");
          break;
        case '\\':
          out.append("\\\\");
          break;
        case '\b':
          out.append("\\b");
          break;
        case '\f':
          out.append("\\f");
          break;
        case '\n':
          out.append("\\n");
          break;
        case '\r':
          out.append("\\r");
          break;
        case '\t':
          out.append("\\t");
          break;
        default:
          if (c < 0x20) {
            out.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
          } else {
            out.append(c);
          }
      }
    }
    return out.append('"').toString();
  }

  private static String jsonLiteral(Object value) {
    if (value == null) {
      return "null";
    }
    if (value instanceof String) {
      return quote((String) value);
    }
    if (value instanceof Number || value instanceof Boolean) {
      return value.toString();
    }
    return quote(value.toString());
  }

  private static final class JsonParser {
    private final String input;
    private int position;

    JsonParser(String input) {
      this.input = input;
    }

    Object parse() {
      skipWhitespace();
      Object value = readValue();
      skipWhitespace();
      if (position != input.length()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Trailing JSON content");
      }
      return value;
    }

    private Object readValue() {
      skipWhitespace();
      if (position >= input.length()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected end of JSON");
      }
      char c = input.charAt(position);
      if (c == '{') {
        return readObject();
      }
      if (c == '[') {
        return readArray();
      }
      if (c == '"') {
        return readString();
      }
      if (c == 't') {
        expectLiteral("true");
        return Boolean.TRUE;
      }
      if (c == 'f') {
        expectLiteral("false");
        return Boolean.FALSE;
      }
      if (c == 'n') {
        expectLiteral("null");
        return null;
      }
      return readNumber();
    }

    private Map<String, Object> readObject() {
      Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
      position++;
      skipWhitespace();
      if (take('}')) {
        return result;
      }
      while (true) {
        skipWhitespace();
        String key = readString();
        skipWhitespace();
        require(':');
        result.put(key, readValue());
        skipWhitespace();
        if (take('}')) {

        }
        require(',');
      }

    private List<Object> readArray() {
      List<Object> result = new ArrayList<>();
      position++;
      skipWhitespace();
      if (take(']')) {
        return result;
      }
      while (true) {
        result.add(readValue());
        skipWhitespace();
        if (take(']')) {
          return result;
        }
        require(',');

        if (position >= input.length()) {
          throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON escape");
        }
        char escaped = input.charAt(position++);
        switch (escaped) {
          case '"':
          case '\\':
          case '/':
            result.append(escaped);
            break;
          case 'b':
            result.append('\b');
            break;
          case 'f':
            result.append('\f');
            break;
          case 'n':
            result.append('\n');
            break;
          case 'r':
            result.append('\r');
            break;
          case 't':
            result.append('\t');
            break;
          case 'u':

            }
            result.append(

            || c == 'e'

    private boolean take(char expected) {

      }
      return false;
    }

    private void require(char expected) {
      if (!take(expected)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected " + expected);
      }
    }

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.

import io.gatling.javaapi.core.*;
import io.gatling.javaapi.http.*;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import static io.gatling.javaapi.core.CoreDsl.*;
import static io.gatling.javaapi.http.HttpDsl.*;

public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation {

  private final HttpProtocolBuilder httpProtocol =
      http.baseUrl(
              System.getenv("BASE_URL") == null
                  ? "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
                  : System.getenv("BASE_URL"))
          .disableFollowRedirect();

  private static Session appendPageProducts(Session session) {
    List<Object> products = new ArrayList<>();
    Object existing = session.get("allProducts");
    Object page = session.get("pageProducts");

    if (existing instanceof List<?>) {
      products.addAll((List<?>) existing);
    }
    if (page instanceof List<?>) {
      products.addAll((List<?>) page);
    }

    return session.set("allProducts", products);
  }

  private static Session selectInStockVariant(Session session) {
    Object allProducts = session.get("allProducts");

    if (allProducts instanceof List<?>) {
      for (Object productObject : (List<?>) allProducts) {
        if (!(productObject instanceof Map<?, ?>)) {
          continue;
        }

        Map<?, ?> product = (Map<?, ?>) productObject;
        Object variantsObject = product.get("variants");
        if (!(variantsObject instanceof List<?>)) {
          continue;
        }

        for (Object variantObject : (List<?>) variantsObject) {
          if (!(variantObject instanceof Map<?, ?>)) {
            continue;
          }

          Map<?, ?> variant = (Map<?, ?>) variantObject;
          Object inStock = variant.get("in_stock");
          boolean available =
              Boolean.TRUE.equals(inStock)
                  || "true".equalsIgnoreCase(String.valueOf(inStock))
                  || "1".equals(String.valueOf(inStock));

          if (available && product.get("id") != null && variant.get("id") != null) {
            return session
                .set("productId", String.valueOf(product.get("id")))
                .set("variantId", String.valueOf(variant.get("id")))
                .set("catalogFound", true);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return session.set("catalogFound", false);
  }

  private ChainBuilder workCall() {
    return exec(
        http("work")
            .post("/v2/work")
            .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
            .body(StringBody("{}"))
            .asJson()
            .check(
                status().saveAs("workStatus"),
                status().in(200, 429),
                header("Retry-After").optional().saveAs("retryAfter"),
                jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf")));
  }

  private final ScenarioBuilder journey =
      scenario("ETag cart journey")
          .exec(
              session -> {
                int account =
                    Math.floorMod(session.userId().toString().hashCode(), 16) + 1;
                return session.set("username", "bench-" + account);
              })
          .repeat(2)
          .on(
              exec(
                  session ->
                      session
                          .remove("csrf")
                          .remove("loginLocation")
                          .remove("challengeLocation")
                          .remove("nextPage")
                          .set("allProducts", new ArrayList<>()))
                  .exec(
                      http("login form")
                          .get("/v2/login-form")
                          .check(
                              status().is(200),
                              css("form input[name='csrf']", "value")
                                  .find()
                                  .saveAs("csrf")))
                  .exec(
                      http("login")
                          .post("/v2/login")
                          .body(
                              StringBody(
                                  "{\"username\":\"#{username}\","
                                      + "\"password\":\"bench\","
                                      + "\"csrf\":\"#{csrf}\"}"))
                          .asJson()
                          .check(
                              status().in(200, 302),
                              jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf"),
                              header("Location").optional().saveAs("loginLocation")))
                  .doIf(session -> session.contains("loginLocation"))
                  .then(
                      exec(
                          http("login redirect")
                              .get("#{loginLocation}")
                              .check(
                                  status().is(200),
                                  jsonPath("$.csrf").saveAs("csrf"))))
                  .exec(
                      http("catalog")
                          .get("/v2/catalog")
                          .check(
                              status().is(200),
                              jsonPath("$.data.products").ofList().saveAs("pageProducts"),
                              jsonPath("$.next").ofString().optional().saveAs("nextPage")))
                  .exec(ModelSimulation::appendPageProducts)
                  .exec(session -> session.set("catalogPages", 1))
                  .asLongAs(

# Public shop protocol

retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.

is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.

GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].

is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.

per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (System.getenv("BASE_URL")).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Java DSL only (io.gatling.javaapi.*); the harness compiles ModelSimulation.java with javac and runs it without reports.
Each Gatling virtual user is one user. Use http(...).check(...) for assertions; a failed check marks the request failed.
No threads, files, sockets, reflection, System.exit or extra libraries.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

import io.gatling.javaapi.core.*;
import io.gatling.javaapi.http.*;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

import static io.gatling.javaapi.core.CoreDsl.*;
import static io.gatling.javaapi.http.HttpDsl.*;

public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation {
  private static final String BASE_URL =
      Optional.ofNullable(System.getenv("BASE_URL"))
          .filter(value -> !value.isBlank())
          .orElse("http://127.0.0.1:8000");

  private final HttpProtocolBuilder httpProtocol =
      http.baseUrl(BASE_URL).disableFollowRedirect();

  private final List<Map<String, Object>> accounts =
      IntStream.rangeClosed(1, 16)
          .mapToObj(i -> Map.<String, Object>of("username", "bench-" + i))
          .toList();

  private final ScenarioBuilder shop =
      scenario("Cookie CSRF shop journey")
          .feed(listFeeder(accounts))
          .repeat(2)
          .on(
              exec(flushCookieJar())
                  .exec(
                      session ->
                          session
                              .remove("csrf")
                              .remove("loginLocation")
                              .remove("challengeLocation")
                              .remove("challengeAction")
                              .remove("challengeValue")
                              .remove("grantId")
                              .remove("productId")
                              .remove("variantId")
                              .remove("cartId")
                              .remove("etag"))
                  .exec(
                      http("GET login form")
                          .get("/v2/login-form")
                          .check(
                              status().is(200),
                              regex(
                                      "(?is)<input\\b(?=[^>]*\\bname\\s*=\\s*['\"]csrf['\"])(?=[^>]*\\bvalue\\s*=\\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"])[^>]*>")
                                  .saveAs("csrf")))
                  .exec(
                      http("POST login")
                          .post("/v2/login")
                          .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                          .body(
                              StringBody(
                                  "{\"username\":\"#{username}\",\"password\":\"bench\",\"csrf\":\"#{csrf}\"}"))
                          .check(
                              status().in(200, 302),
                              jsonPath("$.csrf").saveAs("csrf"),
                              jsonPath("$.user").exists(),
                              header("Location").optional().saveAs("loginLocation")))
                  .doIf(session -> session.contains("loginLocation"))
                  .then(
                      exec(
                          http("GET login redirect")
                              .get("#{loginLocation}")
                              .check(
                                  status().is(200),
                                  jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf"),
                                  jsonPath("$.grant_id").optional().saveAs("grantId"))))
                  .exec(
                      http("GET catalog")
                          .get("/v2/catalog")
                          .check(
                              status().is(200),
                              jsonPath(
                                      "$.data.products[?(@.variants[0].in_stock == true)].id")
                                  .find()
                                  .saveAs("productId"),
                              jsonPath(
                                      "$.data.products[?(@.variants[0].in_stock == true)].variants[0].id")
                                  .find()
                                  .saveAs("variantId")))
                  .exec(
                      http("GET challenge form")
                          .get("/v2/challenge-form")
                          .check(
                              status().is(200),
                              regex(
                                      "(?is)<form\\b[^>]*\\baction\\s*=\\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"][^>]*>")
                                  .saveAs("challengeAction"),
                              regex(
                                      "(?is)<input\\b(?=[^>]*\\bname\\s*=\\s*['\"]challenge['\"])(?=[^>]*\\bvalue\\s*=\\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"])[^>]*>")
                                  .saveAs("challengeValue")))
                  .exec(
                      http("POST challenge")
                          .post("#{challengeAction}")
                          .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                          .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                          .body(StringBody("{\"challenge\":\"#{challengeValue}\"}"))
                          .check(
                              status().is(302),
                              header("Location").saveAs("challengeLocation")))
                  .exec(
                      http("GET challenge result")
                          .get("#{challengeLocation}")
                          .check(
                              status().is(200),
                              jsonPath("$.grant_id").saveAs("grantId"),
                              jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf")))
                  .exec(
                      http("POST cart")
                          .post("/v2/carts")
                          .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                          .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                          .body(
                              StringBody(
                                  "{\"product_id\":\"#{productId}\",\"variant_id\":\"#{variantId}\",\"grant_id\":\"#{grantId}\"}"))
                          .check(
                              status().is(201),
                              jsonPath("$.id").saveAs("cartId"),
                              jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf"),
                              header("ETag").saveAs("etag")))
                  .exec(
                      http("POST order")
                          .post("/v2/orders")
                          .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                          .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                          .header("If-Match", "#{etag}")
                          .header("Idempotency-Key", "#{cartId}")
                          .body(StringBody("{\"cart_id\":\"#{cartId}\"}"))
                          .check(
                              status().is(201),
                              jsonPath("$.accepted").is("true"),
                              jsonPath("$.id").exists())));

  {
    setUp(shop.injectOpen(atOnceUsers(2))).protocols(httpProtocol);
  }
}

Fixture protocol-k6.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (__ENV.BASE_URL).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.
