messages.content: You are a performance test engineer. Follow the task's output contract.

Convert a JMX cookie/CSRF shop plan to Locust without changing its semantics.

Translate the supplied JMX to Locust.

Execution contract: {"users": 2, "iterations": 2, "mode": "flow"}. Non-workload counts are iterations per user. One committed order per journey, no duplicate/extra carts. Two fixture variants count equally; the same artifact is reused without feedback. Fresh owner seeds are recorded after execution. Profiles: [{"login_csrf": true}, {"login_csrf": true, "html_layout": 1, "reverse_catalog": true}]. Negative-control overrides: [].
Rubric/gates (per case: earned fraction capped by every prerequisite fraction; average all cases, never best case):
loads: 10 points — target loads Requires: none.
setup: 25 points — correct defaults/base URL and request bodies Requires: loads.
behavior: 40 points — ordered login/catalog/cart/checkout with correlation Requires: loads, setup.
safety: 25 points — source user/iteration counts and success conditions preserved. Requires: loads, behavior.
Malformed/non-executable artifacts earn zero execution-gated credit. A prerequisite fault can lose multiple checkpoints.

Fixture protocol-locust.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (System.getenv("BASE_URL")).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Java DSL only (io.gatling.javaapi.*); the harness compiles ModelSimulation.java with javac and runs it without reports.
Each Gatling virtual user is one user. Use http(...).check(...) for assertions; a failed check marks the request failed.
No threads, files, sockets, reflection, System.exit or extra libraries.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

import io.gatling.javaapi.core.*;
import io.gatling.javaapi.http.*;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import static io.gatling.javaapi.core.CoreDsl.*;
import static io.gatling.javaapi.http.HttpDsl.*;

public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation {

  private static final HttpProtocolBuilder HTTP_PROTOCOL =
      http.baseUrl(System.getenv().getOrDefault("BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8000"))
          .disableFollowRedirect();

  private static Session resetJourney(Session session) {
    for (String key : List.of(
        "csrf", "loginFormCsrf", "loginLocation", "products",
        "productId", "variantId", "challengeAction", "challengeValue",
        "challengeLocation", "grantId", "cartId", "etag", "patchStatus",
        "reservationStatusUrl", "reservationState", "reservationId",
        "reservationPolls")) {
      session = session.remove(key);
    }
    return session;
  }

  private static Session selectInStockProduct(Session session) {
    List<?> products = session.getList("products");
    if (products != null) {
      for (Object product : products) {
        if (!(product instanceof Map<?, ?> productMap)) {
          continue;
        }
        Object variantsValue = productMap.get("variants");
        if (!(variantsValue instanceof List<?> variants)) {
          continue;
        }
        for (Object variant : variants) {
          if (!(variant instanceof Map<?, ?> variantMap)
              || !Boolean.TRUE.equals(variantMap.get("in_stock"))) {
            continue;
          }
          Object productId = productMap.get("id");
          Object variantId = variantMap.get("id");
          if (productId != null && variantId != null) {
            return session
                .set("productId", String.valueOf(productId))
                .set("variantId", String.valueOf(variantId));
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return session.markAsFailed();
  }

  private static ChainBuilder checkout() {
    return exec(
            http("challenge form")
                .get("/v2/challenge-form")
                .check(
                    status().is(200),
                    regex("(?is)<form\\b(?=[^>]*\\baction\\s*=\\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"])[^>]*>")
                        .saveAs("challengeAction"),
                    regex("(?is)<input\\b(?=[^>]*\\bname\\s*=\\s*['\"]challenge['\"])(?=[^>]*\\bvalue\\s*=\\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"])[^>]*>")
                        .saveAs("challengeValue")))
        .exec(
            http("submit challenge")
                .post("#{challengeAction}")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .body(StringBody("{\"challenge\":\"#{challengeValue}\"}"))
                .check(
                    status().is(302),
                    header("Location").saveAs("challengeLocation")))
        .exec(
            http("challenge result")
                .get("#{challengeLocation}")
                .check(
                    status().is(200),
                    jsonPath("$.grant_id").saveAs("grantId"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf")))
        .exec(
            http("create cart")
                .post("/v2/carts")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .body(StringBody(
                    "{\"product_id\":\"#{productId}\","
                        + "\"variant_id\":\"#{variantId}\","
                        + "\"grant_id\":\"#{grantId}\"}"))
                .check(
                    status().is(201),
                    jsonPath("$.id").saveAs("cartId"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf"),
                    header("ETag").saveAs("etag")))
        .exec(
            http("set cart quantity")
                .patch("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .header("If-Match", "#{etag}")
                .body(StringBody("{\"quantity\":#{quantity}}"))
                .check(
                    status().in(200, 412).saveAs("patchStatus"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf"),
                    header("ETag").optional().saveAs("etag")))
        .doIf(session -> session.getInt("patchStatus") == 412)
        .then(
            exec(
                http("read cart after precondition failure")
                    .get("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")
                    .check(
                        status().is(200),
                        header("ETag").saveAs("etag"),
                        jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf")))
                .exec(
                    http("retry cart quantity once")
                        .patch("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")
                        .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                        .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                        .header("If-Match", "#{etag}")
                        .body(StringBody("{\"quantity\":#{quantity}}"))
                        .check(
                            status().is(200),
                            jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf"),
                            header("ETag").optional().saveAs("etag"))))
        .exec(session -> session
            .set("reservationState", "pending")
            .set("reservationPolls", 0))
        .exec(
            http("create reservation")
                .post("/v2/reservations")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                .body(StringBody("{\"cart_id\":\"#{cartId}\"}"))
                .check(
                    status().is(202),
                    jsonPath("$.status_url").saveAs("reservationStatusUrl"),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf")))
        .asLongAs(session ->
            session.getInt("reservationPolls") < 5
                && !"ready".equals(session.getString("reservationState")))
        .on(
            pause(Duration.ofMillis(50))
                .exec(
                    http("poll reservation")
                        .get("#{reservationStatusUrl}")
                        .check(
                            status().is(200),
                            jsonPath("$.status").saveAs("reservationState"),
                            jsonPath("$.reservation_id").optional().saveAs("reservationId"),
                            jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf")))
                .exec(session ->
                    session.set("reservationPolls", session.getInt("reservationPolls") + 1)))
        .exec(session -> {
          if (!"ready".equals(session.getString("reservationState"))
              || !session.contains("reservationId")) {
            return session.markAsFailed();
          }
          return session;
        })
        .doIf(session ->
            "ready".equals(session.getString("reservationState"))
                && session.contains("reservationId"))
        .then(
            exec(
                http("refresh cart ETag")
                    .get("/v2/carts/#{cartId}")
                    .check(
                        status().is(200),
                        header("ETag").saveAs("etag"),
                        jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf")))
                .exec(
                    http("commit order")
                        .post("/v2/orders")
                        .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                        .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                        .header("If-Match", "#{etag}")
                        .header("Idempotency-Key", "#{cartId}")
                        .body(StringBody(
                            "{\"cart_id\":\"#{cartId}\","
                                + "\"reservation_id\":\"#{reservationId}\"}"))
                        .check(
                            status().is(201),
                            jsonPath("$.accepted").is("true"),
                            jsonPath("$.id").exists(),
                            jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf"))));
  }

  private static ChainBuilder journey() {
    return exec(ModelSimulation::resetJourney)
        .exec(
            http("login form")
                .get("/v2/login-form")
                .check(
                    status().is(200),
                    regex("(?is)<input\\b(?=[^>]*\\bname\\s*=\\s*['\"]csrf['\"])(?=[^>]*\\bvalue\\s*=\\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"])[^>]*>")
                        .saveAs("loginFormCsrf")))
        .exec(
            http("login")
                .post("/v2/login")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .body(StringBody(
                    "{\"username\":\"#{username}\","
                        + "\"password\":\"#{password}\","
                        + "\"csrf\":\"#{loginFormCsrf}\"}"))
                .check(
                    status().in(200, 302),
                    jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf"),
                    header("Location").optional().saveAs("loginLocation")))
        .doIf(session ->
            session.contains("loginLocation")
                && session.getString("loginLocation") != null)
        .then(
            exec(
                http("login redirect target")
                    .get("#{loginLocation}")
                    .check(
                        status().is(200),
                        jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf"))))
        .exec(
            http("catalog")
                .get("/v2/catalog")
                .check(
                    status().is(200),
                    jsonPath("$.data.products").ofList().saveAs("products")))
        .exec(ModelSimulation::selectInStockProduct)
        .doIf(session ->
            session.contains("productId")
                && session.contains("variantId")
                && session.contains("csrf"))
        .then(checkout());
  }

  public ModelSimulation() {
    setUp(
        scenario("Data-driven shop journeys")
            .feed(jsonFile("/fixtures/accounts.json").queue())
            .repeat(2).on(journey())
            .injectOpen(atOnceUsers(2)))
        .protocols(HTTP_PROTOCOL);
  }
}

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (__ENV.BASE_URL).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (System.getenv("BASE_URL")).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Java DSL only (io.gatling.javaapi.*); the harness compiles ModelSimulation.java with javac and runs it without reports.
Each Gatling virtual user is one user. Use http(...).check(...) for assertions; a failed check marks the request failed.
No threads, files, sockets, reflection, System.exit or extra libraries.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

Fixture protocol-k6.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (__ENV.BASE_URL).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

messages.content: You are a performance test engineer. Follow the task's output contract.

Convert a JMX plan's specified iteration pacing into an equivalent Locust workload.

Translate the supplied JMX to Locust.

Execution contract: {"workload": true, "operation": "journey", "path": "/v2/orders", "rate": 2, "max_vus": 4}. Two fixture variants count equally; the same artifact is reused without feedback. Fresh owner seeds are recorded after execution. Profiles: [{}, {"html_layout": 1, "reverse_catalog": true}]. Negative-control overrides: [].
Pool work: POST /v2/orders is a complete owned checkout. Count its checkout request start at the server request start timestamp, only when the owner records a committed order. Login, catalog selection and cart setup are part of the journey but do not count as starts.
First authenticated eligible POST anchors T0, within10s of launch. Warmup5s, score [T0+5,T0+35) in six5s windows, drain<=5s. Count only declared paths/pools; login/setup excluded, health/extra routes forbidden. Journey rate counts committed checkout starts, not HTTP requests. Rate fraction=1 within max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error, linear to0 at40% relative error; average windows equally, with each window capped by the full scored-window mean-rate fraction using the same quantization allowance. Each1s burst<=ceil(1.5*target)+1. Unexpected error/dropped work<=1%; max concurrent virtual users=4. Same-native-runtime capacity must sustain3x target before grading or this is infrastructure-unavailable.
Rubric/gates (per case: earned fraction capped by every prerequisite fraction; average all cases, never best case):
loads: 10 points — target loads Requires: none.
setup: 25 points — business sequence preserved Full window credit allows max(10% of expected arrivals, 1 arrival) count error; average windows with the same quantized full-window mean-rate cap. Requires: loads.
behavior: 40 points — server-observed iteration rate matches the source contract, not the sum of HTTP requests Requires: loads, setup.
safety: 25 points — user count, duration and inter-iteration behavior preserved. Requires: loads.
Malformed/non-executable artifacts earn zero execution-gated credit. A prerequisite fault can lose multiple checkpoints.

Fixture protocol-locust.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (System.getenv("BASE_URL")).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Java DSL only (io.gatling.javaapi.*); the harness compiles ModelSimulation.java with javac and runs it without reports.
Each Gatling virtual user is one user. Use http(...).check(...) for assertions; a failed check marks the request failed.
No threads, files, sockets, reflection, System.exit or extra libraries.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

import io.gatling.javaapi.core.*;
import io.gatling.javaapi.http.*;

import static io.gatling.javaapi.core.CoreDsl.*;
import static io.gatling.javaapi.http.HttpDsl.*;

public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation {
  private static final String BASE_URL =
      System.getenv().getOrDefault("BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8000");

  private final HttpProtocolBuilder httpProtocol =
      http.baseUrl(BASE_URL)
          .disableFollowRedirect();

  private final ChainBuilder journey =
      exec(flushCookieJar())
          .exec(session ->
              session.remove("csrf")
                  .remove("formCsrf")
                  .remove("loginLocation")
                  .remove("challengeAction")
                  .remove("challenge")
                  .remove("challengeLocation")
                  .remove("grantId")
                  .remove("productId")
                  .remove("variantId")
                  .remove("cartId")
                  .remove("etag"))
          .exec(
              http("GET /v2/login-form")
                  .get("/v2/login-form")
                  .check(
                      status().is(200),
                      css("input[name=csrf]", "value").saveAs("formCsrf")))
          .exec(
              http("POST /v2/login")
                  .post("/v2/login")
                  .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                  .body(StringBody(
                      "{\"username\":\"#{username}\","
                          + "\"password\":\"bench\","
                          + "\"csrf\":\"#{formCsrf}\"}"))
                  .check(
                      status().in(200, 302),
                      regex("\"csrf\"\\s*:").exists(),
                      jsonPath("$.csrf").saveAs("csrf"),
                      header("Location").optional().saveAs("loginLocation")))
          .exec(
              doIf(session -> session.contains("loginLocation"))
                  .then(
                      http("GET login redirect")
                          .get("#{loginLocation}")
                          .check(
                              status().is(200),
                              jsonPath("$.csrf").saveAs("csrf"))))
          .exec(
              http("GET /v2/catalog")
                  .get("/v2/catalog")
                  .check(
                      status().is(200),
                      jsonPath(
                          "$.data.products[?(@.variants[0].in_stock == true)].id")
                          .find()
                          .saveAs("productId"),
                      jsonPath(
                          "$.data.products[?(@.variants[0].in_stock == true)].variants[0].id")
                          .find()
                          .saveAs("variantId")))
          .exec(
              http("GET /v2/challenge-form")
                  .get("/v2/challenge-form")
                  .check(
                      status().is(200),
                      css("form", "action").saveAs("challengeAction"),
                      css("input[name=challenge]", "value").saveAs("challenge")))
          .exec(
              http("POST challenge")
                  .post("#{challengeAction}")
                  .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                  .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                  .body(StringBody("{\"challenge\":\"#{challenge}\"}"))
                  .check(
                      status().is(302),
                      header("Location").saveAs("challengeLocation")))
          .exec(
              http("GET challenge redirect")
                  .get("#{challengeLocation}")
                  .check(
                      status().is(200),
                      jsonPath("$.grant_id").saveAs("grantId"),
                      jsonPath("$.csrf").saveAs("csrf")))
          .exec(
              http("POST /v2/carts")
                  .post("/v2/carts")
                  .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                  .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                  .body(StringBody(
                      "{\"product_id\":\"#{productId}\","
                          + "\"variant_id\":\"#{variantId}\","
                          + "\"grant_id\":\"#{grantId}\"}"))
                  .check(
                      status().is(201),
                      regex("\"id\"\\s*:\\s*\"cart-").exists(),
                      jsonPath("$.id").ofString().saveAs("cartId"),
                      header("ETag").saveAs("etag"),
                      jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf")))
          .exec(
              http("POST /v2/orders")
                  .post("/v2/orders")
                  .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                  .header("X-CSRF-Token", "#{csrf}")
                  .header("If-Match", "#{etag}")
                  .header("Idempotency-Key", "#{cartId}")
                  .body(StringBody("{\"cart_id\":\"#{cartId}\"}"))
                  .check(
                      status().is(201),
                      regex("\"accepted\"\\s*:\\s*true").exists(),
                      jsonPath("$.csrf").optional().saveAs("csrf")));

  private final ScenarioBuilder scenario =
      scenario("checkout")
          .exec(session ->
              session.set("username", "bench-" + ((session.userId() % 16) + 1)))
          .repeat(2)
          .on(group("journey").on(journey));

  {
    setUp(scenario.injectOpen(atOnceUsers(2))).protocols(httpProtocol);
  }
}

Fixture protocol-k6.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (__ENV.BASE_URL).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.

            if not OWNER['ready'].wait(5):

            self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
            return

        response, body = self.request('/v2/carts', 'POST',
            {'product_id': product['id'], 'variant_id': variant['id'], 'grant_id': self.grant})

        self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', '')
        if not self.cart:

            headers = {'If-Match': self.etag}
            response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart, 'PATCH',
                                       {'quantity': quantity}, headers)
            if response.status_code == 412:
                response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart)
                self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)
                response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart, 'PATCH',
                    {'quantity': quantity}, {'If-Match': self.etag})
            self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)

            _, body = self.request('/v2/reservations', 'POST', {'cart_id': self.cart})

                     {'Idempotency-Key': self.cart, 'If-Match': self.etag},

            if pool is None:

            if pool.get('operation') == 'journey':
                self.flow()
            else:

        if MODE == 'errors':
            self.login()
            for _ in range(4):
                self.work()
        else:
            self.flow()
        self.iteration += 1
        if self.iteration >= CFG.get('iterations', 2):
            raise StopUser()

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.first_tick = True

    def tick(self):
        users = (CFG.get('max_vus', 64 if CFG.get('capacity') or CFG.get('pools') else 32)
                 if CFG.get('workload') else CFG.get('users', 2))
        elapsed = self.get_run_time()
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            return None if elapsed >= DURATION + 5 else (users, max(1, users))
        if self.first_tick:
            self.first_tick = False
            return users, max(1, users)
        return None if self.runner.user_count == 0 else (users, max(1, users))

import os
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit
from gevent.lock import Semaphore
from locust import HttpUser, LoadTestShape, task
from locust.exception import StopUser

CFG = {"users": 2, "iterations": 2, "mode": "flow"}
BASE_URL = os.environ["BASE_URL"]

_account_lock = Semaphore()
_account_number = 0


class InputParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, wanted_name):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.wanted_name = wanted_name.lower()
        self.value = None

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag.lower() != "input":
            return
        attributes = {key.lower(): value for key, value in attrs if key}
        if (attributes.get("name", "").lower() == self.wanted_name
                and attributes.get("value") is not None
                and self.value is None):
            self.value = attributes["value"]


class ShopUser(HttpUser):
    host = BASE_URL
    wait_time = lambda self: 0

    def on_start(self):
        global _account_number
        with _account_lock:
            _account_number += 1
            account_number = _account_number
        self.username = "bench-" + str((account_number - 1) % 16 + 1)
        self.password = "bench"
        self.csrf = ""
        self.cart = ""
        self.etag = ""
        self.iteration = 0

    def abort(self):
        self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
        raise StopUser()

    def local_path(self, location, relative_to="/"):
        if not location:
            self.abort()
        base = urlsplit(self.host)
        joined = urlsplit(urljoin(self.host.rstrip("/") + relative_to, location))
        if (joined.scheme != base.scheme or joined.netloc != base.netloc
                or not joined.path.startswith("/")):
            self.abort()
        return joined.path + (("?" + joined.query) if joined.query else "")

    def raw(self, path, method="GET", data=None, headers=None, name=None,
            expected_auth_error=True, validator=None):
        method = method.upper()
        request_headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        if method != "GET" and self.csrf:
            request_headers["X-CSRF-Token"] = self.csrf
        request_headers.update(headers or {})

        with self.client.request(
                method, path, json=data, headers=request_headers, name=name,
                catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False, timeout=3) as response:
            try:
                body = response.json()
            except ValueError:
                body = {}

            error = body.get("error") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
            allowed = response.status_code < 400
            if (not allowed and expected_auth_error
                    and response.status_code == 401
                    and error in ("expired", "session")):
                allowed = True

            if (allowed and response.status_code < 400 and validator is not None
                    and not validator(response, body)):
                allowed = False

            if (method == "POST" and path.split("?", 1)[0] == "/v2/orders"
                    and response.status_code < 400
                    and (response.status_code != 201
                         or not isinstance(body, dict)
                         or body.get("accepted") is not True
                         or not body.get("id"))):
                allowed = False

            if allowed:
                response.success()
            else:
                response.failure("request assertion failed")
                self.environment.process_exit_code = 99

            if isinstance(body, dict) and body.get("csrf"):
                self.csrf = body["csrf"]
            return response, body

    def login(self):
        self.csrf = ""
        form_response, _ = self.raw(
            "/v2/login-form", validator=lambda response, body:
            response.status_code == 200)
        if form_response.status_code != 200:
            self.abort()

        parser = InputParser("csrf")
        parser.feed(form_response.text)
        if not parser.value:
            self.abort()

        form_token = parser.value
        self.csrf = form_token
        login_response, login_body = self.raw(
            "/v2/login", "POST",
            {"username": self.username, "password": self.password,
             "csrf": form_token},
            validator=lambda response, body:
            response.status_code == 302 or (
                200 <= response.status_code < 300
                and isinstance(body, dict) and bool(body.get("csrf"))))

        if login_response.status_code >= 400:
            self.abort()

        received_csrf = (
            login_body.get("csrf") if isinstance(login_body, dict) else None
        )
        if login_response.status_code == 302:
            location = login_response.headers.get("Location")
            if not location:
                self.abort()
            redirect_response, redirect_body = self.raw(
                self.local_path(location, "/v2/login"), "GET")
            if redirect_response.status_code >= 400:
                self.abort()
            if isinstance(redirect_body, dict) and redirect_body.get("csrf"):
                received_csrf = redirect_body["csrf"]

        if not received_csrf:
            self.abort()
        self.csrf = received_csrf

    def recover(self, auth_error):
        renew_response, renew_body = self.raw(
            "/v2/session/renew", "POST", {}, expected_auth_error=True)

        renewed = (
            renew_response.status_code == 200
            and isinstance(renew_body, dict)
            and bool(renew_body.get("csrf"))
        )
        if auth_error == "expired" and not renewed:
            self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
            return False
        if auth_error == "session" and not renewed:
            self.login()

        if self.cart:
            cart_path = "/v2/carts/" + self.cart + "/recover"
            response, _ = self.raw(cart_path, "POST", {},
                                   expected_auth_error=False)
            if response.status_code >= 400:
                return False
            self.etag = response.headers.get("ETag", self.etag)
        return True

    def request(self, path, method="GET", data=None, headers=None, name=None,
                validator=None):
        response, body = self.raw(
            path, method, data, headers, name, validator=validator)
        if (response.status_code == 401 and isinstance(body, dict)
                and body.get("error") in ("expired", "session")):
            if not self.recover(body["error"]):
                self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
                return response, body
            retry_headers = dict(headers or {})
            if "If-Match" in retry_headers and self.etag:
                retry_headers["If-Match"] = self.etag
            response, body = self.raw(
                path, method, data, retry_headers, name,
                expected_auth_error=False, validator=validator)
        return response, body

    def flow(self):
        self.client.cookies.clear()
        self.csrf = ""
        self.cart = ""
        self.etag = ""
        self.login()

        page = "/v2/catalog"
        product = None
        for _ in range(3):
            response, body = self.request(page, name="catalog")
            if response.status_code >= 400 or not isinstance(body, dict):
                self.abort()
            products = body.get("data", {}).get("products", [])
            if not isinstance(products, list):
                self.abort()

            product = next(
                (item for item in products
                 if isinstance(item, dict)
                 and any(isinstance(variant, dict)
                         and variant.get("in_stock")
                         for variant in item.get("variants", []))),
                None)
            if product:
                break

            next_page = body.get("next")
            if not next_page:
                break
            page = self.local_path(next_page, page)

        if not product:
            self.abort()

        variant = next(
            item for item in product["variants"]
            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("in_stock"))

        cart_response, cart_body = self.request(
            "/v2/carts", "POST",
            {"product_id": product["id"], "variant_id": variant["id"]},
            name="create cart",
            validator=lambda response, body:
            response.status_code == 201 and isinstance(body, dict)
            and bool(body.get("id")) and bool(body.get("csrf")))

        if (cart_response.status_code != 201
                or not isinstance(cart_body, dict)
                or not cart_body.get("id")):
            self.abort()

        self.cart = str(cart_body["id"])
        self.etag = cart_response.headers.get("ETag", "")
        if not self.etag:
            self.abort()

        cart_path = "/v2/carts/" + self.cart
        order_response, order_body = self.request(
            "/v2/orders", "POST", {"cart_id": self.cart},
            {"Idempotency-Key": self.cart, "If-Match": self.etag},
            name="checkout",
            validator=lambda response, body:
            response.status_code == 201 and isinstance(body, dict)
            and body.get("accepted") is True and bool(body.get("id")))

        if (order_response.status_code != 201
                or not isinstance(order_body, dict)
                or order_body.get("accepted") is not True
                or not order_body.get("id")):
            self.abort()

    @task
    def run_journey(self):
        self.flow()
        self.iteration += 1
        if self.iteration >= CFG["iterations"]:
            raise StopUser()


class JourneyShape(LoadTestShape):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.first_tick = True

    def tick(self):
        users = CFG["users"]
        if self.first_tick:
            self.first_tick = False
            return users, users
        if self.runner.user_count == 0:
            return None
        return users, users

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.

import re

from gevent.lock import Semaphore
from locust import HttpUser, LoadTestShape, task
from locust.exception import StopUser

CFG = {'users': 2, 'iterations': 2, 'mode': 'flow'}
MODE = CFG.get('mode', 'flow')
ROWS = [{"username": "bench-1", "password": "bench", "quantity": 2}, {"username": "bench-2", "password": "bench", "quantity": 3}, {"username": "bench-3", "password": "bench", "quantity": 4}, {"username": "bench-4", "password": "bench", "quantity": 5}, {"username": "bench-5", "password": "bench", "quantity": 6}, {"username": "bench-6", "password": "bench", "quantity": 7}, {"username": "bench-7", "password": "bench", "quantity": 8}, {"username": "bench-8", "password": "bench", "quantity": 9}, {"username": "bench-9", "password": "bench", "quantity": 10}, {"username": "bench-10", "password": "bench", "quantity": 11}, {"username": "bench-11", "password": "bench", "quantity": 12}, {"username": "bench-12", "password": "bench", "quantity": 13}, {"username": "bench-13", "password": "bench", "quantity": 14}, {"username": "bench-14", "password": "bench", "quantity": 15}, {"username": "bench-15", "password": "bench", "quantity": 16}, {"username": "bench-16", "password": "bench", "quantity": 17}]

if isinstance(POOLS, dict):
    POOLS = [dict(pool, name=name) for name, pool in POOLS.items()]

class ArrivalPlan:
    def __init__(self):
        self.started = None
        self.counts = {pool['name']: 0 for pool in POOLS}
        self.lock = Semaphore()

    def slot(self, pool, number):
        rates = CFG.get('rates', [pool['rate']]) if not CFG.get('pools') else [pool['rate']]
        spans = [15, 10, 10] if len(rates) > 1 else [DURATION]
        offset = 0
        for rate, span in zip(rates, spans):
            count = int(rate * span)
            if number < count:
                return offset + number / rate + (
                    number * 0.002 if pool.get('operation') == 'journey' else 0)
            number -= count
            offset += span
        return None

    def next(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.started is None:
                self.started = time.monotonic()
            scheduled = [(self.slot(pool, self.counts[pool['name']]), pool)
                         for pool in POOLS]
            scheduled = [(slot, pool) for slot, pool in scheduled if slot is not None]
            if not scheduled:
                return None
            slot, pool = min(scheduled, key=lambda item: item[0])
            self.counts[pool['name']] += 1
            deadline = self.started + slot
        sleep(max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))

ARRIVALS = ArrivalPlan()
OWNER = {'logins': 0, 'ready': Event(), 'lock': Semaphore()}

class MatrixUser(HttpUser):
    wait_time = lambda self: 0

    def on_start(self):
        number = int(self._p95_worker_id.rsplit('-', 1)[1])
        self.row = ROWS[(number - 1) % len(ROWS)]
        self.username = ('bench' if MODE == 'ownership' else
                         self.row['username'] if MODE in ('data', 'partition') else
                         'bench-' + str((number - 1) % 16 + 1))
        self.password = self.row.get('password', 'bench')
        self.csrf = ''
        self.cart = ''
        self.etag = ''
        self.grant = ''

    def raw(self, path, method='GET', data=None, headers=None, name=None):
        request_headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
        if self.csrf:
            request_headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = self.csrf
        request_headers.update(headers or {})
        with self.client.request(method, path, json=data, headers=request_headers,
                                 name=name, catch_response=True, allow_redirects=False,
                                 timeout=3) as response:
            try:
                body = response.json()
            except ValueError:
                body = {}
            error = body.get('error')
            allowed = (response.status_code < 400
                       or response.status_code == 401 and error in ('expired', 'session')
                       or response.status_code == 412 and error in ('etag', 'etag_conflict')
                       or response.status_code == 429 and path.split('?', 1)[0] == '/v2/work')

                    and body.get('status') == 'failed'

                    and response.status_code < 400

        for _ in range(2):

            if response.status_code == 401 and body.get('error') in ('expired', 'session'):
                self.recover()
                continue
            return response, body

            response, _ = self.request(path, 'POST', {})

        self.etag = ''
        self.grant = ''

            with OWNER['lock']:
                OWNER['logins'] += 1
                if OWNER['logins'] >= CFG.get('users', 2):
                    OWNER['ready'].set()
            if not OWNER['ready'].wait(5):
                self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
                return
            if self._p95_worker_id != 'user-1':
                sleep(0.5)

            page, _ = self.request('/v2/challenge-form')
            action = re.search(
                r'<form\b[^>]*\baction=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', page.text, re.IGNORECASE)
            challenge = re.search(
                r'<input(?=[^>]*\bname=["\']challenge["\'])(?=[^>]*\bvalue=["\']([^"\']+)["\'])[^>]*>',
                page.text, re.IGNORECASE)
            if not action or not challenge:
                self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
                return
            response, _ = self.request(action.group(1), 'POST',
                                       {'challenge': challenge.group(1)})
            location = response.headers.get('Location')
            if location:
                _, body = self.request(location)
                self.grant = body.get('grant_id', '')

        product = None
        for _ in range(3):
            _, body = self.request(page)
            products = body.get('data', {}).get('products', [])
            product = next((item for item in products
                            if any(variant.get('in_stock') for variant in item.get('variants', []))),
                           None)
            if product:
                break
            page = body.get('next')
            if not page:
                break
        if not product:
            self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
            return
        variant = next(item for item in product['variants'] if item.get('in_stock'))
        if not self.cart:
            response, body = self.request('/v2/carts', 'POST',
                {'product_id': product['id'], 'variant_id': variant['id'], 'grant_id': self.grant})
            self.cart = body.get('id', '')
            self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', '')
        if not self.cart:
            return
        if MODE in ('etag', 'data'):
            quantity = self.row.get('quantity', 2) if MODE == 'data' else CFG.get('quantity', 2)
            headers = {'If-Match': self.etag}
            response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart, 'PATCH',
                                       {'quantity': quantity}, headers)
            if response.status_code == 412:
                response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart)
                self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)
                response, _ = self.request('/v2/carts/' + self.cart, 'PATCH',
                    {'quantity': quantity}, {'If-Match': self.etag})
            self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)
        reservation = None
        if MODE == 'reservation':
            _, body = self.request('/v2/reservations', 'POST', {'cart_id': self.cart})
            status_url = body.get('status_url')
            for _ in range(5):
                sleep(0.05)
                _, state = self.request(status_url)
                if state.get('status') == 'ready':
                    reservation = state.get('reservation_id')
                    break
                if state.get('status') == 'failed':

                     {'Idempotency-Key': self.cart, 'If-Match': self.etag},

    def run_scenario(self):
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            pool = ARRIVALS.next()
            if pool is None:
                raise StopUser()
            if pool.get('operation') == 'journey':
                self.flow()
            else:
                self.work(pool['path'])
            return
        if MODE == 'errors':
            self.login()
            for _ in range(4):
                self.work()
        else:
            self.flow()
        self.iteration += 1
        if self.iteration >= CFG.get('iterations', 2):
            raise StopUser()

class MatrixShape(LoadTestShape):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.first_tick = True

    def tick(self):
        users = (CFG.get('max_vus', 64 if CFG.get('capacity') or CFG.get('pools') else 32)
                 if CFG.get('workload') else CFG.get('users', 2))
        elapsed = self.get_run_time()
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            return None if elapsed >= DURATION + 5 else (users, max(1, users))
        if self.first_tick:
            self.first_tick = False
            return users, max(1, users)
        return None if self.runner.user_count == 0 else (users, max(1, users))

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.
